mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID, A.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID) || '.' || B.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_CTG_NM || ' : ' || C.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_NM || ' (' || C.ITEM_WVAL_VAL::int || ')' AS detailText FROM ODS.S_MOPPCIEE A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCIBD B ON A.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID = B.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCICD C ON A.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID = C.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID AND A.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID = C.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} ORDER BY B.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ

SELECT '총점 : ' || B.IFFL_DOR_CTG_GRP_NM || ' (' || A.IFFL_DOR_ASSM_SCR::INT || ')' AS totalText FROM ODS.S_MOPPCIED A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCIDC B ON A.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_ID = B.IFFL_DOR_ASTL_ID AND A.IFFL_DOR_CTG_GRP_CD = B.IFFL_DOR_CTG_GRP_CD WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y'
SELECT B.STF_NM AS writerNm FROM ODS.S_MOPPCIED A INNER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD B ON A.FSR_STF_NO = B.STF_NO WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y'
